info.title: Filinq standard protocol endpoints
info.description: The endpoints of Filinq that implement an external standard (listed in lib/Middleware/Support/StandardProtocolPaths.php). Their URLs, request and error formats are the ones their standard defines, so they keep their unversioned paths and are not part of the versioned API that openapi.json describes.

servers.description: The unversioned base of the paths that implement an external standard, which keep their own URLs and formats.

host.description: The host name of the Nextcloud instance.

get.description: GET /api/health, declarative health check (ADR-006).  Public per ADR-006: an anonymous probe (load balancer, uptime monitor) must reach this without a session. Drives the AppHost engine, which runs the `observability.health` checks declared in src/manifest.json.  When the engine cannot be resolved, openregister absent or disabled, the endpoint still ANSWERS (the entire point of a health probe): `status: degraded`, `checks: {openregister: unavailable}`, HTTP 200.  Rate limiting is an anonymous CEILING rather than a per-account counter, because a liveness probe carries no credential to count against.

GET /api/metrics, declarative Prometheus metrics (admin-only, ADR-006).  Drives the AppHost metrics engine. Returns HTTP 503 with a Prometheus comment line when the engine is unavailable (openregister absent or disabled), never a 500.

200.description: Back to the request page, with the outcome in the query.

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem details. Members the endpoint returned before, such as `error` or `message`, are kept.

type.description: A URI that identifies the problem type.

title.description: The HTTP reason phrase of the status.

detail.description: What went wrong, for this occurrence.

API-Version.description: The version of the API that answered, which is the installed app version.

basic_auth.description: A Nextcloud user name with an app password.
